proven: Automatic facts expire at 30 days, also after restart; repeated reads and derivation replay never renew their original deadline
Proposals remain outside inference, expire with their actual raw sources and cannot be permanently confirmed by a voice command or forged metadata
Only authenticated dashboard review records permanent confirmation with actor and date; expired proposals fail and stale rejection cannot delete a concurrently confirmed memory
Legacy Chroma collection and preferences JSON remain unchanged and excluded from automatic prompts, even when legacy metadata labels a preference explicit
Actual capture and conversation UUIDs propagate from ambient distillation and both voice routes; one completed voice exchange is recorded exactly once
Both actual voice routers retrieve authoritative memory into the synthetic HTTP/SSE generation request and deliver one audio response
A conversation tombstone blocks in-flight and replayed fact derivation after restart; this test covers the fact catalogue, not deletion across all stores
Index failure retains durable deletion work; stale upserts cannot acknowledge a newer deletion and stale index content remains excluded from inference
Partial distillation retries preserve the first successful fact ID and expiry without marking the whole source batch done prematurely
Actual maintenance expires catalogue and index; short-term reads enforce the actual shorter source deadline or a maximum of 48 hours
Native memory work stays bounded at eight operations, remains tracked after caller cancellation, and close reports unfinished ownership rather than abandoning it
A persistent writer lease prevents two policy writers for the same ledger and the ledger file has mode 0600
Main uses the shared memory factory; the compiled CPython 3.13 artifact imports and exercises proposal, confirmation, deletion and owned lifecycle without source files
